review_method: Every assigned title and complete ItemBody were inspected in the frozen snapshot and rendered HTML; every listed local PNG tile was individually opened with tools.view_image at original resolution. No HTTP(S) or live-site access was used.
notes: All item source SHA-256 hashes match assignment-02.json; all snapshot files hash identically to current source.
All rendered HTML hashes match assignment-02.json.
All 110 screenshot tile hashes match the per-item capture receipts.
Screenshot boundaries are individual capture crops; no clipping defect was asserted from crop edges alone.
CSS uppercase technique banners and block-line rendering of wikilinks/reference titles are expected behavior; raw TeX delimiters/commands inside technique banners are a rendering defect.

findings.symptom: The all-caps technique banner renders TeX-like source literally (`S\ELL(U)` in the banner) while mathematical prose and inline/display math below render. The body formula is a technique field, not a diagram.
The all-caps technique banner exposes TeX-like source (`$S\NE\EMPTYSET$`) instead of typesetting it. Other display math in the body renders normally.
The title displays `mu(a) = -2(c-1)^{-1}a` as literal ASCII formula notation, unlike rendered math in the ItemBody. This is a title rendering limitation/defect rather than a body math failure.

diagram_candidates.content: Draw the regular hexagon with cyclic vertices v0,…,v5, centre o, six boundary edges, the short diagonal v0v2, and diameter v0v3. Label side length 1 and straight-line distances d(v0,v1)=1, d(v0,v2)=√3, d(v0,v3)=2 beside graph distances 1,2,3. Optionally show one barycentric triangle v-m-o with legs 1/2 and √3/2.
diagram_candidates.why: The statement gives explicit vertex coordinates and contrasts cell geodesic distance with graph path distance; a figure would make the precise compared paths and index convention directly inspectable. The coordinate and distance claims are already verified algebraically in the source.
checks: Source lines 38 and 45 enumerate the vertex cycle and face subdivision.
Source lines 47–49 state the three metric/graph distances and their inequality.

diagram_candidates.content: For A2 and I2(5), draw the 3 and 5 root lines through the origin, label the positive root rays and number the six or ten sectors by the stated alternating words u_k; for I2(∞), show the two affine-line wall traces 0,1 and intervals (j,j+1), alongside the two root strings e_s+ku and e_t+ku. Keep the three cases separate so finite and degenerate/infinite geometry are not conflated.
diagram_candidates.why: The source explicitly identifies roots, inversion sets, cyclic chamber order, and wall-separation sectors; these are naturally geometric data, and figures can expose orientation/index errors without serving as proof.
checks: A2 cyclic sector order and separating walls: source line 40.
I2(5) ten sectors and negative half-plane chamber ranges: source lines 42–47.
Infinite case root strings and affine interval traces: source lines 49–53.

diagram_candidates.content: For the stated codimension-two face, show 2m incident alcoves cyclically, with p,q panel labels alternating and boundary word (σpσq)^m; include m=2,3 examples only if a generic 2m cycle is clear.
diagram_candidates.why: The item expressly identifies the local link as a finite dihedral arrangement and states an alternating panel cycle and boundary relation. A small schematic can clarify the orientation and word-reading convention.
checks: Source line 75 states line angle π/m and allowed labels.
Source line 77 gives cycle length 2m and the two possible starting orientations.

map_orientation_checks.check: The two displayed simple reflections act by (x,y)↦(y,x) and (x,y)↦(x,−y); right-to-left composition gives (x,y)↦(−y,x), a positive quarter-turn of order four. The A2 root orbit has the six expected signed roots and the stated index [P:Q]=3. No sign/order mismatch found.

With right-to-left permutation multiplication and the stated bipartite order (12),(34),(23), c=(1 2 4 3) has order four; the six listed prefix reflections and simple-root coordinates follow the stated convention. The second half is the negative roots with the listed order/signs. No index or sign mismatch found.

The cyclic coordinates give side lengths 1 and distances |v0−v1|=1, |v0−v2|=√3, |v0−v3|=2; modulo-six edge steps give graph distances 1,2,3. The stated A2 action maps the two adjacent vertices v1,v5 and their generator names consistently. No orientation/index/sign mismatch found.
